rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an argument or failure to agree between people.

example.english: We had a dispute over the homework for a long time.
example.traditional: 我同佢為咗份功課爭拗咗好耐。
example.jyutping: ngo5 tung4 keoi5 wai6 zo2 fan6 gung1 fo3 zang1 aau3 zo2 hou2 noi6

rows.note: Use this for a dispute between parties in a legal, contractual, or other formal matter.

example.english: The dispute over this contract has already been referred to a lawyer.
example.traditional: 呢宗合約糾紛已經交咗畀律師處理。
example.jyutping: ni1 zung1 hap6 joek3 gau2 fan1 ji5 ging1 gaau1 zo2 bei2 leot6 si1 cyu2 lei5

rows.note: Use this when the dispute is a verbal debate or controversy about an issue.

example.english: This issue has sparked a lot of dispute online.
example.traditional: 呢個議題喺網上引起咗好多爭論。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 ji6 tai4 hai2 mong5 soeng6 jan5 hei2 zo2 hou2 do1 zang1 leon6
